## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope and decisions

Link relevant requirements or decisions. Identify assumptions still awaiting confirmation.

## Verification

Describe checks actually run and their results. For documentation-only changes, verify links and instructions. For UI changes, include relevant screenshots and workflow checks.

## Remaining work

List unresolved inputs, limitations, and follow-up tasks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the agreed requirements.
- [ ] Setup instructions reflect the change.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unapproved assets are included.
- [ ] Verification above reflects checks actually performed.
